connector.name: MCP Sidecar
connector.registryDescription: Cross-platform MCP server for managing long-lived background processes from any MCP client
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-sidecar. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.

env.name: SIDECAR_MAX_PROCESSES
env.description: Maximum number of concurrent managed processes (default: 10)

env.name: SIDECAR_BUFFER_SIZE
env.description: Output buffer size per stream in bytes (default: 1048576)

env.name: SIDECAR_KILL_TIMEOUT
env.description: Milliseconds to wait between graceful and forced termination (default: 5000)

env.name: SIDECAR_CLEANUP_AFTER
env.description: Seconds before exited processes are auto-removed. 0 disables cleanup (default: 1800)

env.name: SIDECAR_MAX_OUTPUT_SIZE
env.description: Global cap on bytes returned by the output tool. 0 means unlimited (default: 0)

env.name: SIDECAR_ALLOWED_EXECUTABLES
env.description: Comma-separated allowlist of executable names. When set, enables security mode with direct exec (no shell). Unset means security disabled.

env.name: SIDECAR_BLOCKED_PATTERNS
env.description: Comma-separated regex patterns to reject in commands. Only applies when security is enabled.

env.name: SIDECAR_AUDIT_LOG
env.description: Audit log destination. 'true' writes to cwd, 'temp' writes to OS temp dir, or a directory path. Unset disables audit logging.
